	}

# Province scope. A random natural illness starts here, weighed by its column and its habitat (S5, doc 84).
DA_ILL_spawn = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } }   # S4 (doc 83): Houses of Healing IV
		random_list = {
			6 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_1 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_1 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_1 = yes } }   # Marsh Fever
			6 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_2 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_2 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_2 = yes } }   # Red Cough
			6 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_3 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_3 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_3 = yes } }   # Flu
			6 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_4 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_4 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_4 = yes } }   # Gutrot
			3 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_5 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_5 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_5 = yes } }   # Duskwither Plague
			3 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_6 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_6 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_6 = yes } }   # Silent Pox
			3 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_7 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_7 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_7 = yes } }   # Redblight
			3 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_8 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_8 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_8 = yes } }   # Chulklung
			2 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_9 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_9 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_9 = yes } }   # Mana Overload
			2 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_10 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_10 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_10 = yes } }   # Mana Corruption
			2 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_11 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_11 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_11 = yes } }   # Metallic Corrosion
			2 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_12 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_12 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_12 = yes } }   # Soulblight
			1 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_13 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_13 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_13 = yes } }   # Dreams of Reality
			1 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_14 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_14 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_14 = yes } }   # Godscar
			1 = { modifier = { factor = 3 DA_ILL_habitat_15 = yes } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_15 = yes } DA_ILL_infect_15 = yes } }   # White Thorns
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (a player). The new cases of every illness: carried out by the standing order, or asked about.
# It fires the hidden event DA_ILL.4, which runs DA_ILL_announce_now: EU4 copies a scripted effect into every
# place that calls it when the game loads, and the announcement is large (doc 111).
DA_ILL_announce = {
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_ILL.4 } }
}
# The announcement itself, run by DA_ILL.4 only (call DA_ILL_announce).
DA_ILL_announce_now = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_announce
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } } DA_ILL_announce_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } } DA_ILL_announce_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } } DA_ILL_announce_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } } DA_ILL_announce_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } } DA_ILL_announce_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } } DA_ILL_announce_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } } DA_ILL_announce_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } } DA_ILL_announce_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } } DA_ILL_announce_9 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } } DA_ILL_announce_10 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion } } DA_ILL_announce_11 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight } } DA_ILL_announce_12 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality } } DA_ILL_announce_13 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar } } DA_ILL_announce_14 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } } DA_ILL_announce_15 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins } } DA_ILL_announce_16 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } } DA_ILL_announce_17 = yes }
		if = { limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } } DA_ILL_announce_18 = yes }
	}
}
DA_ILL_announce_1 = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_1 value = 1 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_1 value = 2 } DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } } DA_ILL_quarantine = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_1 value = 3 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_burn = yes } DA_ILL_burn = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_1 value = 4 } has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Marsh_Fever }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } if = { limit = { owner = { treasury = 30 } } DA_ILL_cure = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_1 } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_asking_1 days = 60 } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_1 value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_1 value = 1 } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_1
			set_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_1
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_1 value = 2 } } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.201 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_1 value = 2 } } } random_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Medicine_event.100 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}
# Province scope: the outbreak event of this province was answered.
DA_ILL_answered_1 = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case
		owner = { clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_1 DA_ILL_announce_1 = yes }
	}
}
# Country scope: the event about several new cases was answered.
DA_ILL_multi_done_1 = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_1
		DA_ILL_announce_1 = yes
	}
}
DA_ILL_announce_2 = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_2 value = 1 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_2 value = 2 } DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } } DA_ILL_quarantine = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_2 value = 3 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_burn = yes } DA_ILL_burn = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_2 value = 4 } has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Red_Cough }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } if = { limit = { owner = { treasury = 20 } } DA_ILL_cure = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_2 } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_asking_2 days = 60 } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_2 value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_2 value = 1 } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_2
			set_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_2
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_2 value = 2 } } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.202 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_2 value = 2 } } } random_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Medicine_event.101 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}

	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_16 value = 2 } } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.216 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_16 value = 2 } } } random_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Medicine_event.140 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}

		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case
		owner = { clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_16 DA_ILL_announce_16 = yes }
	}

DA_ILL_announce_17 = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_17 value = 1 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_17 value = 2 } DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } } DA_ILL_quarantine = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_17 value = 3 } }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_burn = yes } DA_ILL_burn = yes } clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_ILL_order_17 value = 4 } has_country_flag = DA_researched_illness.Bender_of_Will }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } if = { limit = { owner = { treasury = 80 } } DA_ILL_cure = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_17 } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_asking_17 days = 60 } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_17 value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_17 value = 1 } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_17
			set_country_flag = DA_ILL_asking_17
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_17 value = 2 } } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.217 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_new_17 value = 2 } } } random_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Medicine_event.141 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}

# Province scope. The AI's answer to a new case: cure it when it can, quarantine it with Medicine I, burn
# White Pestilence without Medicine, otherwise let it run (doc 78, 6.12).
DA_ILL_ai_new_case = {
	owner = { DA_ILL_export_realm = yes }
	if = { limit = { DA_ILL_can_cure = yes } DA_ILL_cure = yes }
	if = { limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes owner = { DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes } NOT = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } } DA_ILL_quarantine = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence owner = { NOT = { DA_completed.Medicine_1 = yes } } DA_ILL_can_burn = yes } DA_ILL_burn = yes }
}
# Country scope (AI). A cure is researched when an illness is in 3 or more of its provinces.

			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_ai_started } num_of_owned_provinces_with = { value = 3 has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } DA_ILL_can_research_2 = yes } DA_ILL_research_2 = yes set_country_flag = DA_ILL_ai_started }

# Country scope. The realm's illness resistance and quarantine efficiency into the variables the scripts and the
# window read (the old yearly export does it for players only).
DA_ILL_export_realm = {
	hidden_effect = {
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_yearly_illness_spawn_chance_counter value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_illness_spawn_chance_counter }
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_quarantine_efficiency }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.9 } } set_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.9 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency_shower which = DA_quarantine_efficiency }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency_shower value = 100 }
	}
}

# Province scope. A quarantine in the weight the owner's quarantine efficiency allows (doc 78, 6.4).
DA_ILL_quarantine = {
	hidden_effect = {
		remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_province
		remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_ordered
		remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_cordon
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } } owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.25 } } } } add_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_province duration = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } } owner = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.25 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.5 } } } } add_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_ordered duration = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.25 } } } } add_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_ordered duration = -1 } }   # S4 (doc 83)
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } } owner = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.5 } } } add_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_cordon duration = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } owner = { check_variable = { which = DA_quarantine_efficiency value = 0.25 } } } add_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_cordon duration = -1 } }   # S4 (doc 83)
}
DA_ILL_lift_quarantine = {
	remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_province
	remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_ordered
	remove_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Quarantined_cordon
}

# Province scope. The illness leaves; the province is immune to it for ten years.
DA_ILL_heal = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_heal_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Marsh_Fever duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Red_Cough duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Flu duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Gutrot duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Duskwither_Plague duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Silent_Pox duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Redblight duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Chulklung duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Mana_Overload duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Mana_Corruption duration = 3650 } if = { limit = { has_building = mage_tower } owner = { DA_MT_refresh = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Metallic_Corrosion duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Soulblight duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Dreams_of_Reality duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Godscar duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.White_Thorns duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Seven_Deadly_Sins duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.Bender_of_Will duration = 3650 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } remove_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_immune.White_Pestilence duration = 3650 } }
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_sick
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_new_case
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_burning
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_silent   # S5 (doc 84)
	}
}
# Province scope. A known cure: 10 ducats x (severity + complexity).
DA_ILL_cure = {
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } owner = { add_treasury = -30 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } owner = { add_treasury = -20 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } owner = { add_treasury = -30 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } owner = { add_treasury = -30 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } owner = { add_treasury = -50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } owner = { add_treasury = -50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } owner = { add_treasury = -40 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } owner = { add_treasury = -50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } owner = { add_treasury = -60 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } owner = { add_treasury = -70 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion } owner = { add_treasury = -60 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight } owner = { add_treasury = -50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality } owner = { add_treasury = -90 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar } owner = { add_treasury = -70 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } owner = { add_treasury = -90 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins } owner = { add_treasury = -90 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } owner = { add_treasury = -80 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } owner = { add_treasury = -100 } }
	DA_ILL_heal = yes
}

# Province scope. Burning by severity (doc 78, 6.6): each point costs one development, 5 devastation, 4 unrest
# and 6 months of fire; the illness stops spreading and is gone 1 to 3 months later.
DA_ILL_burn = {
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } DA_ILL_burn_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } DA_ILL_burn_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } DA_ILL_burn_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } DA_ILL_burn_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } DA_ILL_burn_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } DA_ILL_burn_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Soulblight } DA_ILL_burn_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Dreams_of_Reality } DA_ILL_burn_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } DA_ILL_burn_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins } DA_ILL_burn_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Bender_of_Will } DA_ILL_burn_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } DA_ILL_burn_5 = yes }
}
DA_ILL_burn_1 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_burn_dev_1_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_lose_manpower = yes
	}
	add_devastation = 5
	add_unrest = 4
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_Medicine.Burning_province duration = 180 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_burn_end_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_province_flag = DA_ILL_burning
		province_event = { id = DA_ILL.20 days = 30 random = 60 }
	}
}

DA_ILL_lose_manpower = {
	if = { limit = { base_manpower = 2 } add_base_manpower = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_production = 2 } add_base_production = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_tax = 2 } add_base_tax = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done
}
DA_ILL_lose_production = {
	if = { limit = { base_production = 2 } add_base_production = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_tax = 2 } add_base_tax = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_manpower = 2 } add_base_manpower = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done
}
DA_ILL_lose_tax = {
	if = { limit = { base_tax = 2 } add_base_tax = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_manpower = 2 } add_base_manpower = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done } base_production = 2 } add_base_production = -1 set_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done }
	clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_dev_done
}

# Province scope. The local illness resistance (doc 78, 6.5): the realm's plus the province's own, -90 to +90.
DA_ILL_local_resistance = {
	hidden_effect = {
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_realm value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_illness_spawn_chance_counter who = owner }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R which = DA_ILL_R_realm }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_hosp value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Hospital_0 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_hosp value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Hospital_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_hosp value = 20 } }
		if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Hospital_2 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_hosp value = 30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_building = DA_Hospital_3 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_hosp value = 40 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R which = DA_ILL_R_hosp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_life value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mage_Tower_Specialization.Universal_Law_Life } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_life value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mage_Tower_Adept.Universal_Law_Life } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_life value = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mage_Tower_Master.Universal_Law_Life } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_life value = 20 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R which = DA_ILL_R_life }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_heal value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_1 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_heal value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_2 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_heal value = 20 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_3 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_heal value = 30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.healing_4 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_R_heal value = 40 } }

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sp value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sp value = 100 } }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sp value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_spq value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_spq value = 100 } }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ILL_spq value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fd value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fd value = 100 } }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fd value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fdq value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fdq value = 100 } }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fdq value = 0 }
	}
}
# Province scope. A number from 1 to 100, each as likely (two dice of ten faces); only in hidden events.
DA_ILL_roll = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 1 }
		random_list = {
			10 = { }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 10 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 20 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 30 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 40 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 50 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 60 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 70 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 80 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 90 } }
		}
		random_list = {
			10 = { }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 1 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 2 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 3 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 4 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 5 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 6 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 7 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 8 } }
			10 = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 9 } }
		}
	}
}
# Province scope (a sick province, ROOT its owner, in the hidden yearly check). Spread, then fading.
DA_ILL_check_province = {
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_local_resistance = yes
		DA_ILL_chances = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_csp which = DA_ILL_sp }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_cfd which = DA_ILL_fd }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_csp which = DA_ILL_spq } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_cfd which = DA_ILL_fdq } }
		DA_ILL_roll = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_csp which = DA_ILL_roll } } DA_ILL_spread = yes }
		DA_ILL_roll = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_cfd which = DA_ILL_roll } } DA_ILL_heal = yes ROOT = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_well value = 1 } } }
	}
}
DA_ILL_spread = {
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } DA_ILL_spread_1 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } DA_ILL_spread_2 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } DA_ILL_spread_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } DA_ILL_spread_4 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } DA_ILL_spread_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } DA_ILL_spread_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } DA_ILL_spread_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } DA_ILL_spread_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } DA_ILL_spread_10 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Metallic_Corrosion } DA_ILL_spread_11 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Godscar } DA_ILL_spread_14 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } DA_ILL_spread_15 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } DA_ILL_spread_18 = yes }
}
DA_ILL_spread_1 = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_neighbor_province = {
			limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_1 = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes }
				export_to_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_quarantine_efficiency who = owner }
				multiply_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } }
			}
			DA_ILL_roll = yes
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block which = DA_ILL_roll } } } DA_ILL_infect_1 = yes }
		}
	}
}

DA_ILL_spread_3 = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { development = 20 any_neighbor_province = { DA_ILL_can_catch_3 = yes development = 20 } } set_province_flag = DA_ILL_prefer }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_prefer }
			random_neighbor_province = {
				limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_3 = yes development = 20 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes }
					export_to_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_quarantine_efficiency who = owner }
					multiply_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 100 }
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } }
				}
				DA_ILL_roll = yes
				if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block which = DA_ILL_roll } } } DA_ILL_infect_3 = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_prefer } }
			random_neighbor_province = {
				limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_3 = yes }
				set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes }
					export_to_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = modifier:DA_fake_medicine_quarantine_efficiency who = owner }
					multiply_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 100 }
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 90 } }
				}
				DA_ILL_roll = yes
				if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block which = DA_ILL_roll } } } DA_ILL_infect_3 = yes }
			}
		}
		clr_province_flag = DA_ILL_prefer
	}
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_prefer } }
			random_neighbor_province = {
				limit = { DA_ILL_can_catch_4 = yes }
				set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_block value = 0 }

# Country scope. The yearly check of a country with a sick province (the hidden event DA_ILL.1).
DA_ILL_yearly_check = {
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_export_realm = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_well value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_lifted value = 0 }
		# an illness from before doc 81 has no flag: it is checked from the next year on
		every_owned_province = { limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_sick } } set_province_flag = DA_ILL_sick }
		every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ILL_silent } DA_ILL_reveal = yes }   # S5 (doc 84): Silent Pox comes to light
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes OR = { had_province_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_sick days = 330 } ROOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_test_now } } }
			DA_ILL_check_province = yes
		}
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Medicine.Burning_province } OR = { had_province_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_sick days = 330 } ROOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_test_now } } }
			DA_ILL_roll = yes
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_roll value = 21 } } } DA_ILL_dead_rise = yes }
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_ILL_test_now   # (the test event, DA_ILL.900)
		# a quarantine weighs what the efficiency allows now, and ends when its province and its neighbours are clean
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes } NOT = { any_neighbor_province = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes } } }
				DA_ILL_lift_quarantine = yes
				ROOT = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_lifted value = 1 } }
			}
			if = { limit = { DA_ILL_is_quarantined = yes } DA_ILL_quarantine = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { ai = yes } DA_ILL_ai_research = yes }
		DA_ILL_epidemic_check = yes   # S5 (doc 84): an epidemic begins or ends
		if = {
			limit = { ai = no OR = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_well value = 1 } check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rep_lifted value = 1 } } }
			country_event = { id = DA_ILL.30 }
		}
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_ILL_announce } DA_ILL_announce = yes }
	}
}
# Country scope (on_yearly_pulse_5).
DA_ILL_yearly_pulse = {
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_inborn_sync = yes   # S5 (doc 84)
		if = { limit = { ai = yes } DA_ILL_export_realm = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { any_owned_province = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes } has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic } } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.1 } }
	}
}
# Country scope (a player, on_monthly_pulse): the numbers the province view shows.
DA_ILL_monthly = {
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_inborn_sync = yes   # S5 (doc 84)
		DA_ILL_export_realm = yes
		every_owned_province = {
			DA_ILL_local_resistance = yes
			if = { limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes } DA_ILL_chances = yes }
		}
	}
}
# Province scope: the numbers of one province, when its Medicine panel opens.
DA_ILL_province_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = {
		owner = { DA_ILL_export_realm = yes }
		DA_ILL_local_resistance = yes
		DA_ILL_chances = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. What the Illnesses page shows: this year's chances at the realm's resistance (before a
# province's own) and how many of our sick provinces are quarantined or caught it this year.
DA_ILL_window_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		DA_ILL_export_realm = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fs which = DA_yearly_illness_spawn_chance_counter }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fs value = -200 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fs value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_ff which = DA_yearly_illness_spawn_chance_counter }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_ILL_ff value = 200 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_ff value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fp value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_food_tier_1 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fp value = 0.9 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_food_tier_2 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fp value = 0.8 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_food_tier_3 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fp value = 0.7 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_food_tier_4 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_fp value = 0.6 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_hp value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_health_tier_1 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_hp value = 1.1 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_health_tier_2 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_hp value = 1.2 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_health_tier_3 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_hp value = 1.3 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_ILL_health_tier_4 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_hp value = 1.4 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_q1 value = 1 }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_ILL_q1 which = DA_quarantine_efficiency }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_q2 value = 1 }

		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Universal_Law_Death.1 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rfdq_16 value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Universal_Law_Death.2 } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rfdq_16 value = 15 } }

		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_physicians } multiply_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rfd_16 value = 1.5 } multiply_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rfdq_16 value = 1.5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rsp_16 value = 100 } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_rsp_16 value = 100 } }

		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_y_16 value = 0 }

			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Seven_Deadly_Sins }

			if = { limit = { NOT = { had_province_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_sick days = 365 } } } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_y_16 value = 1 } } }
		}

	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_cure_all_1_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } if = { limit = { owner = { treasury = 30 } } DA_ILL_cure = yes } }
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }

# ======== S5 (doc 84): Medicine content

# Country scope. Inoculation: for twenty years the illness cannot break out or spread in our provinces.
DA_ILL_inoculate_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 5 }
		add_treasury = -50
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_inoculated.Marsh_Fever duration = 10950 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Cold_Chains } }
		DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 10 }
		add_treasury = -100
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_inoculated.Marsh_Fever duration = 7300 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_inoculate_1_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_inoc_last value = 1 }
		country_event = { id = DA_ILL.40 }
	}
}

# Province scope (the province view). A company of Plague Doctors: local illness resistance +50 for two years.
DA_ILL_hire_doctors = {
	owner = { add_treasury = -50 }
	add_province_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_plague_doctors duration = 730 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_doctors_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_ILL_local_resistance = yes
		if = { limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes } DA_ILL_chances = yes }
		province_event = { id = DA_ILL.41 }
	}
}
# Country scope. Inborn Resistance (Medicine IV), kept with the level: in older saves too.
DA_ILL_inborn_sync = {
	if = { limit = { DA_completed.Medicine_4 = yes NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_inborn_resistance } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_inborn_resistance duration = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Medicine_4 = yes } has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_inborn_resistance } remove_country_modifier = DA_ILL_inborn_resistance }
}
# Province scope. The dead rise from White Pestilence (the roll is in the yearly check): the AI's at once, a
# player's through the event that tells of it.
DA_ILL_dead_rise = {
	if = { limit = { owner = { ai = yes } } spawn_rebels = { type = DA_Undead_rebels size = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owner = { ai = no } } province_event = { id = DA_ILL.60 } }
}
# Country scope (the yearly check). An epidemic: one illness in 5 of our provinces or a tenth of them, whichever is more.
DA_ILL_epidemic_check = {
	hidden_effect = {
		export_to_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_line value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_line value = 10 }
		round_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_line value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_line value = 5 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_line value = 5 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Marsh_Fever } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Red_Cough } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Flu } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 3 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Gutrot } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 4 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Duskwither_Plague } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 5 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Silent_Pox } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 6 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Redblight } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 7 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Chulklung } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 8 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Overload } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 9 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }
			every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.Mana_Corruption } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 1 } } }

		}
		if = {

			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Thorns } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = DA_Disease.White_Pestilence } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_n value = 0 }

			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_n } set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_ill value = 18 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic } check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_line } } DA_ILL_epidemic_start = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ILL_epi_max which = DA_ILL_epi_line } } } DA_ILL_epidemic_end = yes }
	}
}
# Country scope. The epidemic begins: a player is asked how to meet it, the AI answers at once.
DA_ILL_epidemic_start = {
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_epidemic duration = -1 }
	if = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.50 } }
	if = { limit = { ai = yes } DA_ILL_ai_epidemic = yes }
}
DA_ILL_ai_epidemic = {   # the physicians when the treasury allows it, otherwise prayers
	if = { limit = { treasury = 300 adm_power = 150 } add_treasury = -100 add_adm_power = -25 add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_epidemic_physicians duration = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_physicians } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_epidemic_prayers duration = -1 } }
}
# Country scope. The epidemic ends: its burdens go; prayers are answered (a player's in the event that tells of it).
DA_ILL_epidemic_end = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic
	remove_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_roads
	remove_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_physicians
	if = { limit = { ai = yes has_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_prayers } add_stability = 1 remove_country_modifier = DA_ILL_epidemic_prayers }
	if = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_ILL.51 } }
}
# Country scope (the window's refresh). The Overview's Medicine lines: the realm's resistance, our sick provinces and
# how many of them caught it this year.
DA_ILL_overview_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		DA_ILL_export_realm = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sick_n value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sick_new value = 0 }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { DA_has_disease_in_province = yes }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sick_n value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { had_province_flag = { flag = DA_ILL_sick days = 365 } } } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ILL_sick_new value = 1 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}


# ======== S6 (doc 86): remedies

# Country scope. A remedy: for five years the illness spreads half as often and fades half as fast again in our
# provinces (DA_ILL_chances). Its price follows its column.
DA_ILL_remedy_1 = {
	DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 5 }
	add_treasury = -50
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Frost_Rune_Cellars }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_remedy.Marsh_Fever duration = 3650 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Frost_Rune_Cellars } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_remedy.Marsh_Fever duration = 1825 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_remedy_1_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_SCH_refresh = yes }
}

DA_ILL_remedy_14 = {
	DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 20 }
	add_treasury = -200
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Frost_Rune_Cellars }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_remedy.Godscar duration = 3650 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Frost_Rune_Cellars } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ILL_remedy.Godscar duration = 1825 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_ILL_remedy_14_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_SCH_refresh = yes }
}
